title: Resolutions
description: A list of the resolutions that the World Congress can enact.

voterDecision.title: Voter Decision
voterDecision.description: What the voters decide: yes or no, or a major civilization (host election, World Leader).

proposerDecision.title: Proposer Decision
proposerDecision.description: What the proposer chooses when proposing the resolution.

requiredTechAnyMember.title: Required Tech Any Member
requiredTechAnyMember.description: The resolution can be proposed only when a living civilization knows this tech.

playerProposable.title: Player Proposable
playerProposable.description: False for resolutions that only the World Congress proposes.

exclusive.title: Exclusive
exclusive.description: Only one instance can be proposed or in effect, whatever the choice.

leadersVoteBonusOnFail.title: Leaders Vote Bonus On Fail
leadersVoteBonusOnFail.description: Delegates that the civilizations leading the vote get more when the vote fails.

votesForFollowingReligion.title: Votes For Following Religion
votesForFollowingReligion.description: Delegates more for a civilization that follows the chosen religion in most of its cities.

votesForFollowingIdeology.title: Votes For Following Ideology
votesForFollowingIdeology.description: Delegates more for a civilization that follows the chosen ideology.

holyCityTourismPercent.title: Holy City Tourism Percent
holyCityTourismPercent.description: Percent more tourism from the holy city of the chosen religion.

religionSpreadStrengthPercent.title: Religion Spread Strength Percent
religionSpreadStrengthPercent.description: Percent more spread strength of the chosen religion.

ideologyPressure.title: Ideology Pressure
ideologyPressure.description: Ideological pressure of the chosen ideology on every civilization.

projectCostPerPlayer.title: Project Cost Per Player
projectCostPerPlayer.description: More than 0 makes the resolution a League project: enacting it starts the project, to which the cities contribute production. The cost for each civilization at Standard speed.

embargoesCityStates.title: Embargoes City-States
embargoesCityStates.description: Trade routes with city-states are forbidden.

embargoesPlayer.title: Embargoes Player
embargoesPlayer.description: Trade routes with the civilization chosen by the proposer are forbidden.

bansLuxuryHappiness.title: Bans Luxury Happiness
bansLuxuryHappiness.description: The luxury chosen by the proposer gives no happiness and cannot be traded.
